items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: all these guys, Gene Ammons, and Bird, and all these guys would come up there

ctx.x: Sadik and he worked with you...

At the Paradise, yeah, he stayed with me a long time. I saw Timmie the other night at the Village Vanguard and I...you see I had to change drummers because, you know, all these guys, Gene Ammons, and Bird, and all these guys would come up there and Art Blakey and Max Roach and all these guys, so I had to get a drummer with just a little bit more experience and it broke my heart and I know it hurt him too, you know, but he understood, you know. Yeah.
